title: Owner: check the full dashboard and the simple view on the Mac and the installed phone app
goal: The owner confirms every section works in the full workspace dashboard, the simple view shows only its essentials, and push taps still confirm delivery
acceptance: On the Mac, open the full dashboard after the update: each section shows live data and an idle poll reloads nothing; switching the theme between plain and EVA changes both layouts

On the Mac and the phone, open the simple view: it shows the chat, pending approvals, health at a glance, push on/off and a link to the full dashboard, and nothing else; the link opens the full dashboard and back
On the phone, the installed app opens the workspace
validation: Owner visual and device check, recorded in F-130 Verification
escalation: The owner decides whether the dashboard matches; the agent records the result

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a walk through every section and one push tap. Re-estimated 2026-11-25 (+0.5 h): the simple view and the theme switch too. Not a measurement. 2026-11-26: the push-tap check moved out, it is F-004-T10's (owner-step triage); -0.25 h.
